role: A chat line to display: the IChatComponent and whether it goes to the chat or system bar.

members.name: field_148919_a (message)
members.note: the component's JSON and its iterated parts in the packet's side part

members.name: field_148918_b (type)
members.note: neither written on the wire (writePacketData sends the component alone) nor read by NetHandlerPlayClient.handleChat

members.name: S02PacketChat
members.note: EntityPlayerMP.addChatComponentMessage (the bed, build.tooHigh) and ServerConfigurationManager.func_148539_a (the death message, the achievement)

members.name: readPacketData
members.note: the integrated server's local channel passes packets as objects (NetworkManager.provideLocalClient adds no codec)

members.name: writePacketData
members.note: the byte codec: the local channel passes the packet object (NetworkManager.provideLocalClient adds no codec). The JSON it would write is IChatComponent.Serializer's, which Rows.s02 runs on every S02 and csrc/engine/chatcomp.c chat_json matches

members.name: processPacket
members.note: handleChat's only effect is GuiNewChat.func_146227_a (printChatMessage), the live client's chat list: GuiNewChat's record and the pixel lane's item N-02; the packet reaches the client's queue (s2c_in) for it

members.name: S02PacketChat
members.note: the decoder's ctor only: Packet.generatePacket instantiates it by reflection (newInstance) for bytes read off a socket (MessageDeserializer); the integrated server's local channel passes packet objects with no codec (NetworkManager.provideLocalClient adds only the packet_handler), so it never runs

notes: Every S02 the server sends is compared per row: the oracle's rows carry each tick's S02s (Rows.s02: the IChatComponent.Serializer JSON and GuiNewChat's iterated parts) and test_snapshots and play --check compare csrc/engine/chatcomp.c chat_s02_check against the queue (lane/idxchat, DEVLOG 2026-09-27). The senders: BlockBed.onBlockActivated (tile.bed.occupied, noSleep, notSafe: csrc/engine/sleep.c), EntityPlayerMP.onDeath (csrc/engine/survival.c surv_server_death), StatisticsFile.func_150873_a (surv_add_stat), NetHandlerPlayServer.processPlayerBlockPlacement (build.tooHigh: surv_server_use_packet). The join and leave lines fall outside every row (before the snapshot, after the session). chat.cannotSend and typed chat need C01PacketChatMessage (not_needed). idxaudit 2026-09-27: was client_cosmetic/not_applicable; the scope reason did not hold (DEVLOG 2026-09-27, lane/idxaudit).
scope_reason: In scope: its handler prints the line into GuiNewChat (NetHandlerPlayClient.handleChat), which is in scope: the HUD draws chat lines for 200 ticks and the recorded frames judge them (test_hudscreens). Achievement, death, bed and join messages all arrive this way.
